18. INSTALL SECOND COAST BRAKE COVER, PISTON ASSEMBLY AND SPRING
(a) Coat two new O-rings with ATF and install them to the cover.
(b) Install the spring, piston assembly and cover to the case.
(c) Using SST, install the snap ring.
SST 09350-30020 (09350-07060)

19. CHECK PISTON ROD STROKE OF SECOND COAST BRAKE
(a) Place a mark on the second coast brake piston rod as shown in the figure.

(b) Using SST, measure the stroke applying the compressed air (4 — 8 kg/cm², 57 — 114 psi or 392 — 785 kPa) as shown in the figure.
SST 09240-00020
Piston rod stroke: 1.5 — 3.0 mm (0.059 — 0.118 in.)
If it is still more than standard value, replace the brake band with a new one.
